scope: S1-S2 software-only Go baseline versus configured dispatch selection; no SDK calls or physical validation

environment.build: Release for console runners; isolated Debug build for actual plugin
environment.isolation: External system-temp baseline git archive and current source snapshot; shared Go binary built only in baseline scratch; external CLI_HOME, NuGet and Go caches. AGENT_HAPTICS_LOG overrides every measured hook event path. Production files, service and mouse untouched.

origins.baseline: Unmodified archived Program.cs, StopEventReader and StopEventMonitor: ReadNewStops count callback, not the new compatibility adapter
origins.configured: Working-tree typed StopEventMonitor.ForRecords + real HapticsConfigurationStore.Snapshot + HapticsEventRouter.BackendEvent, stopping at TestPulse selection

methodology.order: One baseline block, then one configured block, then the hook-only diagnostic; not interleaved or counterbalanced
methodology.boundary: Stopwatch timestamp immediately before Process.Start(/bin/sh -c absolute-Go-path) through count callback (baseline) or TestPulse selection callback (configured). Includes .NET launcher, shell, Go append, native file notification and C# ingestion. Does not wait for hook process exit in measured interval; exit is checked afterward.
methodology.startup: 200 ms settle and 8 s idle before sampling each C# path; no event warmups discarded. Compilation and configuration startup parse excluded.
methodology.pauses: Random(42), 17-170 ms between samples, one outstanding event at a time
methodology.monitor: FileSystemWatcher with 1000 ms reconciliation in both paths
methodology.configuration_io: Real JSON file parsed once by HapticsConfigurationStore before monitor construction and sample loop; one immutable Snapshot lookup per received batch, no Reload and no Go configuration reads
methodology.percentiles: C# median_ms is the existing harness lower middle order statistic (30th of 60), not the average of the two central samples; p95 is nearest rank (57th of 60). Python median uses statistics.median.
methodology.outliers: No samples removed. Baseline maximum 198.9351 ms retained; its cause was not instrumented. No claim that it is configuration cost or that configured routing is faster.
methodology.limits: Independent sequential processes on a non-dedicated host; JIT, process launch, scheduler and filesystem noise not isolated. No reload timing, concurrent-load timing, real SDK dispatch, Codex event-arrival timing or physical vibration timing. Idle/RSS are diagnostics, not sustained resource estimates.

hook_only_stdout.boundary: spawn configured shell through process exit; timestamp metadata precedes file write

hook_only_note: One mode only: the unchanged script's interleaved label is vacuous here. Five warmups plus 60 recorded samples. This is a separate process-exit boundary, not an additional latency to sum with the C# results.

verification.configuration: 10 groups; 33 invalid cases; all passed using SDK 8
verification.reader: Existing reader/notification suites and nine typed/compatibility/concurrency PASS groups passed
verification.plugin_doubles: 10 behavior groups passed; no actual SDK calls
verification.plugin_debug: Actual PluginApi reference, build succeeded, 0 warnings and 0 errors; scratch output only, no installation/reload
verification.harness_self_test: PASS configured dispatch: parsed startup snapshot, TestPulse, both gates, unrelated event, history, no replay; PASS preserved legacy count consumption
verification.preservation_command_both_trees: dotnet run --project tests/latency/Latency.csproj -c Release -- 1 poll250 poll25 watcher hook250 hookwatcher hook_python_static hook_go_static
verification.preservation: All seven existing modes exited 0 with identical stderr completion lines and matching JSON schema/mode/sample count/callback nullability. Raw stdout timing/resource values differ and were retained separately; these one-sample smoke checks are not latency distributions. GIT_DIR plus per-tree GIT_WORK_TREE made legacy Git-resolving modes use each isolated source tree without changing baseline source. No production CLI parser/helper was edited.
verification.initial_failures: Self-test RED was CS0103 for missing DispatchConfigured (compile-level, not behavioral RED). First configuration validation failed MSB3030 because the scratch snapshot omitted the public example/schema; after copying those unchanged fixtures, the same command passed. An initially overstrict differential assertion equated measured idle_callbacks; poll25 observed 321 baseline versus 320 current in separate timed windows. The corrected structural check on the same captured results passed; the raw difference was not normalized away.
